answer: Rotating challenge ledger. Each identity must solve a fresh, randomly generated task tied to the current ledger epoch, and the solution seeds the next epoch's task so it cannot be precomputed. Agents must wander across evolving task spaces rather than replay cached answers. Every attempt costs one hardware-attested compute proof stored on a basalt-anchored append-only log. Attacker cost: a new unique solution per epoch per identity, forcing real-time compute per sybil, not a fable of reused work.
